https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: People’s tribunal urges US to compensate Korean victims of A-bombings
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: The US atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945 were war crimes against civilians, so the US government ought to compensate the Korean victims, an international people’s tribunal has ruled. The International People’s Tribunal on the 1945 Atomic Bombings found in a preliminary judgment on Sunday that the US bombings of the two Japanese cities in August 1945 constituted war crimes, violating international legal prohibitions on direct attacks on civilians even during total war. The bombings killed approximately 210,000 people, including 40,000 Koreans.
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p2: The tribunal concluded that the US government is obligated to compensate the Korean victims. The Organizing Committee of the International People’s Tribunal on the 1945 Atomic Bombings and the Korean civic group Solidarity for Peace and Reunification of Korea (SPARK) convened the tribunal from Nov. 13 to 15 at Hanshin University’s Graduate School of Theology in the Suyu neighborhood of Seoul’s Gangbuk District. As the tribunal was organized by civilians, its judgment is not legally binding. Nevertheless, it marks the first attempt in the world to put the US government on trial for its use of atomic bombs. In its judgment, the panel of judges found that “atomic bombings constituted war crimes and crimes against humanity under customary international law as it stood in 1945.” “The atomic bombings constituted war crimes, as the wanton destruction of cities was not justifiable by military necessity. They also constituted crimes against humanity, as they were planned acts of mass killing directed against civilians,” the judges found. The judges also concluded that “the United States is under an obligation under international law to compensate Korean atomic bomb victims for the harm they suffered” — and, indeed, continue to suffer — “as a result of the atomic bombings.” The judges found that the bombings violated prohibitions against direct attacks on civilians, indiscriminate attacks and methods of warfare that “would violate laws of humanity and public conscience.” They also concluded that the bombings exceeded what was necessary for legitimate military purposes and violated the requirements of necessity and proportionality. Twelve Korean plaintiffs participated in the proceedings, including seven individuals who survived direct exposure to the bombings, as well as four second-generation victims and one third-generation victim with conditions attributed to their parents’ and grandparents’ radiation exposure. Among them was Shim Jin-tae, head of the Hapcheon chapter of the Korea Atomic Bombs Victim Association.

https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: US-China-Russia summit mustn’t become a ‘second Yalta,’ says South Korea’s top diplomat
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: South Korea’s foreign minister said a summit between North Korea and the US on the sidelines of this week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, remains possible but unlikely. Seoul’s top diplomat also said he had conveyed to China that any decisions reached at a potential summit between the leaders of the US, China and Russia must not undermine South Korea’s national interests. Speaking to reporters at the Korean Embassy in Beijing on Saturday, Foreign Minister Cho discussed his meeting with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi the previous day, which lasted about 90 minutes and was followed by a dinner. A senior South Korean Foreign Ministry official said the Chinese side had shared its assessment of the prospects for a North Korea-US summit. “Ultimately, the most important variables are the situation in the US and President Donald Trump’s willingness to hold a summit. Another variable is how receptive North Korea will be,” the official said. “Taking everything into account, we cannot rule out the possibility under the current circumstances,” the official continued. “We need to be prepared and ensure that our national interests aren’t compromised.” Seoul also conveyed its opposition to a repeat of the 1945 Yalta Conference, at which the major powers decided the postwar international order without involving the countries that were directly affected. “If a US-China-Russia summit takes place, it must not become a ‘second Yalta Conference,’“ the official said. “We’ve made it clear not only to the US but also to China that our national interests cannot be compromised on matters concerning the Korean Peninsula. We made that position abundantly clear again yesterday.” The official said that China understands South Korea’s position that the three powers must not make decisions that would grant North Korea recognition as a nuclear-armed state or thwart efforts to establish a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula. The South Korean delegation also received an update on recent exchanges between China and North Korea. The official said the Chinese side had provided “relatively detailed accounts” of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s visit to Dandong on Oct. 24 and Korean Workers’ Party international secretary Kim Song-nam’s visit to China on Nov. 5. “The Chinese side described relations with North Korea as focusing more on economic cooperation than on political matters, and that was very much the impression I came away with,” the official said. Cho said that he had emphasized that peace on the Korean Peninsula was a “vital interest” for South Korea and that Wang had agreed that peace and stability on the peninsula were also in China’s national interest. Regarding bilateral relations, Cho said China had expressed its intention to give President Lee Jae Myung a special welcome during his visit for the APEC summit. With the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations approaching next year, the two countries agreed that discussions would continue at the working level about concrete cooperation projects with a meaningful public impact that can be announced at the APEC summit next week. The talks also covered longstanding issues raised by Korea, including Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The Chinese said they would make a good-faith effort to address those issues. Cho said the two sides also agreed on the need to reduce negative sentiment among their respective populations and move bilateral relations in a mutually positive direction.

https://www.kmib.co.kr/list/598.title: 국민일보
https://www.kmib.co.kr/list/598.p2: 아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 정상회의 참석을 위해 필리핀을 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 “지정학적 갈등과 경제적 불확실성이 심화될수록 한국과 아세안은 더 긴밀히 연대해야 한다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 필리핀 수도 마닐라에서 열린 한·아세안 정상회의 모두발언에서 “국제 정세의 불확실성이 커질수록 역내 협력의 구심점인 아세안의 역할이 더욱 중요해지고 있다”며 “대한민국은 ‘아세안 중심성’을 확고히 지지한다“고 말했다. 이 대통령은 양측 간 공조가 초국가적 치안 협력 분야에서 빛을 발하고 있다고 강조하면서 “한국과 아세안은 온라인에서부터 바다에 이르기까지 양측 국민의 생명과 안전을 함께 지켜나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 또 “한·아세안 자유무역협정(FTA) 개선 협상도 시작됐다”며 “변화하는 글로벌 통상 환경에 선제적으로 대응하며 연간 교역액 3000억 달러 시대를 향해 나아가겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이번 정상회의를 계기로 ‘한·아세안 인공지능(AI) 동행 이니셔티브’와 ‘한·아세안 문화 창조산업 이니셔티브’를 제안했다. 이를 통해 AI 기술 발전 혜택을 양국 국민이 함께 누리게 하고, 아세안 청년의 문화적 창의성이 구체적 성과로 이어지는 데 한국이 기여하겠다는 것이다. 이어진 비공개 회의에서 아세안 각국 정상은 이 대통령이 지난해 제시한 ‘한·아세안 포괄적 전략동반자 관계(CSP) 비전’의 성과를 높이 평가하고, 이를 계속 이행·지지하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다고 김성완 청와대 대변인이 서면브리핑에서 밝혔다. 김 대변인은 “각국 정상은 한·아세안 FTA 개선 협상 타결과 AI·디지털 전환, 에너지·전력망 등 분야에서의 협력 강화와 초국가 범죄 공동대응 등을 희망했다”고 전했다. 이에 이 대통령은 아세안 기대에 부응하기 위해 CSP의 각 비전별 구체적인 협력사업 계획을 제시했다. 이 대통령은 한·메콩 정상회의를 갖고 메콩강 유역 5개국(캄보디아·라오스·미얀마·태국·베트남)과 협력 강화 방안도 논의했다. 이 대통령은 “대한민국이야말로 메콩 국가들의 발전 과정을 함께할 최적의 파트너”라며 “한·아세안 CSP 비전을 실현하는 과정에서 메콩의 역동성과 잠재력이 발휘될 수 있도록 적극 지원하고 7대 중점 협력 분야를 중심으로 실질적이고 호혜적인 협력을 더욱 강화하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 순방 첫날인 이날 아누틴 찬위라꾼 태국 총리, 페르디난드 로무알데스 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령과 각각 정상회담을 갖고 양국 간 협력 확대 방안을 논의했다. 한·태국 정상회담에서는 양 정상이 포괄적 경제동반자협정(CEPA)의 조속한 타결에 공감을 표하면서 협상을 가속하기로 했다. 또 필리핀과의 정상회담에서는 방산과 인프라 등 협력 분야에서 호혜적 협력을 심화하고 조선·AI·원전·우주 등 유망 분야에서 미래지향적 협력을 확대 발전시켜 나가기로 했다고 김 대변인이 전했다.

http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.title: North Korea nixed unification from its constitution. What we should prepare for
http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.p1: North Korea has removed references to unification from its constitution. On Wednesday, North Korea released the full text of its revised constitution through Naenara, a state-run propaganda website. The constitution, amended by the Supreme People’s Assembly on March 23, removed provisions concerning peaceful reunification and the great unity of the Korean nation. Instead, it introduced a new provision defining North Korea’s territory as bordering China and Russia to the north and South Korea to the south. The constitutional framework that once viewed the two Koreas as one nation destined for reunification has effectively been abandoned.
http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.p2: This is more than a change in wording. Since late 2023, Kim Jong Un has defined inter-Korean relations as a relationship between two hostile states. The following year, he ordered the removal of references to unification from the constitution. North Korea has since rejected the idea that the two Koreas belong to the same nation and shifted toward treating South Korea as a separate state rather than a partner for reconciliation and reunification. The publication of the revised constitution confirms that these political declarations have now been incorporated into the country’s highest legal framework. North Korea is changing the very way it defines its relationship with South Korea .

https://www.etnews.com/20261117000207.title: [人사이트] 최종복 직스테크놀로지 대표 “CAD 국산화 다음은 설계 생태계 혁신” - 전자신문
https://www.etnews.com/20261117000207.p1: “직스캐드 AX로 경쟁 제품을 대체하고 AI를 넣어 한 단계 나아갔다면, 다음은 설계 생태계를 바꾸는 단계입니다. 국산 컴퓨터지원설계(CAD)의 기술력과 생태계를 키워 국내 기업의 외산 소프트웨어(SW) 의존도를 낮추겠습니다.” 최종복 직스테크놀로지 대표는 최근 본지와 인터뷰에서 이같이 강조했다. 국내 고객과 협력해 확보한 실무 도면을 인공지능(AI)에 학습시키고, 이를 설계 현장에 맞는 제품 경쟁력으로 발전시키겠다는 구상이다. 직스테크놀로지는 외산 CAD 제품을 유통하며 쌓은 경험과 수익을 자체 개발에 투자해 지난 2022년 직스캐드 첫 버전을 출시했다. 그간 연구·개발(R&D)에 300억원 이상을 투입했고, 한화오션·삼성물산·현대스틸·국방과학연구소 등 대기업과 공공기관으로 고객 기반을 넓히고 있다. 국산 CAD '직스캐드 AX', AI 공간 설계 플랫폼 '직스 스페이스', 건설현장 관제 플랫폼 '다이브' 등을 개발하고 있다. 최 대표는 “대기업은 단순히 저렴하다고 제품을 도입하지 않고 수개월간 테스트와 검토를 거친다”며 “최근 국내 대기업과 중견기업이 외산 CAD에서 직스 CAD로 바꾸기 시작했다는 것은 이 같은 과정을 모두 통과했다는 점에서 의미가 있다”고 말했다. 최 대표가 내세운 기술 자산은 실무 도면의 확보 규모와 이를 활용한 AI 학습 경험이다. AI 공간 설계 플랫폼 '직스 스페이스'는 10만 장 이상의 도면을 학습한 모델을 활용한다. 외산 경쟁사보다 국내 고객의 도면을 많이 확보해 자체 AI 모델에 학습시켜 왔다는 설명이다. 최 대표는 “데이터는 양뿐 아니라 품질이 매우 중요하다”며 “고객이 현업에서 사용하는 고품질 도면을 자체 모델에 계속 학습시켜 실제 설계 업무에 필요한 성능을 높이고 있다”고 설명했다. 이어 “국내 산업 현장의 도면 데이터와 자체 AI 기술을 바탕으로 국산 CAD 생태계를 키워가겠다”고 덧붙였다. 특히 직스테크놀로지는 설계 분야 AI 전환(AX)에 속도를 내고 있다. AI가 종이·이미지 도면을 인식해 수정 가능한 설계 데이터로 바꾸고, 이를 2D·3D 공간 구성과 시뮬레이션에 활용하도록 돕는다. 확보한 시간은 더 다양한 설계안을 검토하고 공간의 품질을 높이는 데 활용할 수 있다. 최 대표는 “기획과 실시설계에 시간이 많이 들어가면 디자인 품질을 높일 시간이 부족해진다”며 “더 많은 대안을 시뮬레이션하고 사람이 더 나은 공간을 선택하도록 돕는 것이 AX의 가치”라고 설명했다. 도면 보안도 제품 경쟁력의 중요한 축이다. 국정원의 국가정보보안기본지침, 방위사업청의 방위산업보안업무훈 등과 같은 고객사 보안 요구에 맞춰 기능을 추가 개발한 바 있다. 또한 이외에도 고객사들과 협업 과정에서 도면 공유를 통제하고 외부 유출 시 열람을 제한하는 기능에도 투자하고 있다. 최 대표는 “기업이 수개월, 수년간 투자해 만든 도면에는 수많은 노하우가 담겨 있다”며 “협업 과정의 유출을 최소화하고 도면이 외부로 나갔더라도 열람을 제한하는 등 보안 기능 강화에 힘을 쏟고 있다”고 말했다. 회사는 글로벌 사업 확대 발판 마련을 위해 기업공개(IPO)를 준비하고 있다. 상장 주관사 실사를 마쳤으며, 2027년 거래소 상장 심사 청구와 2027~2028년 상장을 목표로 준비하고 있다. 최 대표는 “글로벌 진출을 앞당길 자금을 확보하고 해외 고객에게 한국 상장사라는 신뢰를 주기 위해 상장을 추진한다”고 설명했다. 이어 “직스 스페이스의 연내 정식 출시를 추진하고, 내년 1월 CES 2027에서 글로벌 론칭에 나설 계획”이라면서 “미국·일본·베트남 등에서는 사업·기술 협력을 추진하는 등 글로벌 사업에 속도를 내겠다”고 덧붙였다. 강성전 기자 castlekang@etnews.com

https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CF%81%CF%8.title: Ρωσία: Το Κρεμλίνο αφήνει ανοιχτή συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον Κιμ
https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CF%81%CF%8.p1: Μια πιθανή συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας Κιμ Γιονγκ Ουν εξαρτάται από την παρουσία του δεύτερου στη σύνοδο Οικονομικής Συνεργασίας Ασίας-Ειρηνικού, στη Σεντζέν της Κίνας. Αυτό δήλωσε ο εκπρόσωπος του Κρεμλίνου Ντμίτρι Πεσκόφ, απαντώντας σε ερώτηση για το ενδεχόμενο επαφής των δύο ηγετών. Νωρίτερα, ο πρόεδρος των Ηνωμένων Πολιτειών Ντόναλντ Τραμπ είχε επίσης αναφέρει ότι ενδέχεται να συναντηθεί με τον Κιμ. Ο Πεσκόφ μίλησε τη Δευτέρα σε δημοσιογράφους και αναφέρθηκε παράλληλα στον σχεδιασμό των επαφών του Ρώσου προέδρου με τον Αμερικανό ομόλογό του. Οι δύο επιλογές για τη συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον Τραμπ Για το αναμενόμενο τετ α τετ των δύο προέδρων, ο εκπρόσωπος του Κρεμλίνου δήλωσε ότι δεν έχει καθοριστεί ακριβής ώρα. Περιγράφοντας τη μορφή που προτιμά η ρωσική πλευρά, είπε: «Μία επιλογή που θα προτιμούσαμε είναι μια προσυμφωνημένη συνάντηση — χωριστά, για να μιλήσουν ήρεμα επί μία ώρα ή περισσότερο». Ως εναλλακτική, ο Πεσκόφ ανέφερε μια κατ’ ιδίαν συνομιλία στο περιθώριο της συνόδου. Για την τελική επιλογή περιορίστηκε να πει: «Θα δούμε πώς θα εξελιχθεί». Η τριμερής της Σεντζέν και η παρακολούθηση από τη Σεούλ Νωρίτερα είχε γίνει γνωστό ότι οι Τραμπ, Σι Τζινπίνγκ και Πούτιν θα συναντηθούν στις 19 Νοεμβρίου, στο περιθώριο της ίδιας διοργάνωσης. Οι τρεις ηγέτες έχουν ήδη συνομιλήσει ανά δύο, αλλά η προγραμματισμένη τριμερής θα αποτελέσει την πρώτη επίσημη κοινή διαπραγμάτευσή τους. Η Νότια Κορέα είχε δηλώσει ότι παρακολουθεί την προετοιμασία των συνομιλιών ΗΠΑ, Κίνας και Ρωσίας. Τη θέση αυτή είχε διατυπώσει ο πρώτος υφυπουργός Εξωτερικών Παρκ Γιουν-τζου, όταν η τριμερής συζητούνταν ακόμη ως ενδεχόμενο. SBC Red Line Για τον Έλληνα αναγνώστη, αξίζει να παρακολουθηθεί ποιες από τις διμερείς επαφές θα πραγματοποιηθούν τελικά. Η διάκριση ανάμεσα στην προγραμματισμένη τριμερή και στις επαφές που παραμένουν υπό συζήτηση είναι ουσιαστική για την αποτίμηση της συνόδου. https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611171910.p1: 이달 초 일주일간 동료 교수들과 함께 유럽의 안보 관련 국제기관과 연구소들을 방문하였다. 우선 벨기에 브뤼셀에 소재한 북대서양조약기구(NATO.나토) 본부를 방문하여 인도태평양 지역 담당자들과 함께 나토와 한국 간의 안보협력 현황 및 향후 과제에 대해 의견을 나누었다. 이어 영국 런던으로 옮겨 세계적 안보연구기관인 국제전략문제연구소(IISS)에서 영국 및 독일 등에서 참가한 다른 연구자들과 함께 한국·유럽 안보협력 방안에 대해 워크숍을 가졌다. 그리고 영국 왕립합동군사연구소(RUSI)를 방문하여 영국을 포함한 나토 국가들과 안보협력 관련 이슈들에 대해 논의하였다.

https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.title: Japan and Regional Leaders Strengthen Ties at Manila Summit | News On Japan
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.p1:
MANILA -
 Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi joined U.S. President Donald Trump and the leaders of Australia and India for a Quad summit in Manila on November 17th, where Trump described the four countries' relationships as among the world's most important partnerships and drew attention to Takaichi's toughness during an exchange with reporters.
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.p2: The meeting brought together Takaichi, Trump, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi as the four countries sought to strengthen cooperation on regional security, economic resilience, energy and emerging technologies. Speaking ahead of the summit, Trump emphasized the close relationships among the four nations, saying they represented some of the most important partnerships in the world. He also made a lighthearted remark about the personalities of his fellow leaders, describing Modi as a very tough man before suggesting that Takaichi might be even tougher. The comment came as the four leaders gathered for photographs and answered questions from reporters, providing a moment of humor ahead of discussions on regional and international challenges. At the summit, Takaichi welcomed the opportunity to hold the first Quad leaders' meeting involving the current four leaders and expressed appreciation for Trump's participation. "The Quad has always contributed to peace in this region," Takaichi said, emphasizing that the four countries would continue working with regional partners to shape the future of the Indo-Pacific. She identified maritime security, economic security, energy and critical emerging technologies as priority areas for cooperation, arguing that stronger regional independence and resilience were essential to achieving a free and open Indo-Pacific. Takaichi also called for renewed momentum behind the Quad, describing it as a strategically important framework capable of delivering practical results for countries across the region. The four leaders reaffirmed their opposition to unilateral attempts to change the status quo through force or coercion and expressed serious concern about economic pressure, including arbitrary export restrictions. They also discussed the protection of critical supply chains, maritime cooperation and energy security. The Quad meeting was part of an extensive diplomatic schedule for Takaichi in Manila, where she participated in several ASEAN-related gatherings and held bilateral talks with regional leaders. At the ASEAN Plus Three summit, bringing together the 10 ASEAN members with Japan, China and South Korea, Takaichi emphasized the importance of practical cooperation in maintaining regional stability and prosperity. She highlighted financial cooperation, food security, disaster response and efforts to combat organized crime as areas where the participating countries could deepen their partnerships. Takaichi said Japan would continue supporting ASEAN's central role and unity in regional diplomacy while promoting her vision of an evolved Free and Open Indo-Pacific, designed to help countries strengthen their independence and resilience. At the fourth Asia Zero Emission Community summit, Takaichi outlined proposals aimed at simultaneously strengthening energy security, supporting economic growth and advancing decarbonization. She called for the AZEC framework to evolve into a more ambitious second phase, describing energy security and economic resilience as increasingly important challenges for Asian economies. Among the proposals was the establishment of an Asian oil security task force, working with the International Energy Agency to develop rules for emergency oil releases and improve coordination among regional countries. Takaichi also proposed a new IEA base in Tokyo and greater cooperation on petroleum stockpiles, including arrangements linked to a joint reserve initiative led by the Philippines. Other priorities included expanding the use of biofuels, promoting small modular nuclear reactors and developing next-generation energy technologies. She announced plans for a Bridge Asia Initiative to encourage the development of a common Asian market in advanced industries, while working with the Asian Development Bank and other institutions to accelerate transition financing and investment in green transformation. Takaichi also promoted closer economic and energy cooperation between Asian consumers and oil-producing countries in the Middle East under the Power Gulf initiative. Rejecting the argument that climate action necessarily damages economic performance, she said environmental protection and economic growth could be achieved together. At the Japan-ASEAN summit, Takaichi reaffirmed Japan's commitment to a regional order based on freedom, openness, diversity, inclusiveness and the rule of law. She welcomed the adoption of a joint statement on economic resilience, saying stronger partnerships with ASEAN countries would contribute to regional prosperity. Japan also hosted its first summit with Mekong countries in six years, with Takaichi describing the Mekong region as a key part of her Indo-Pacific strategy. She pledged continued Japanese support for sustainable development, reliable artificial intelligence and digital technologies, improved regional connectivity, stable energy supplies and stronger supply chains. Takaichi also met Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, referring to their conversations at a dinner the previous evening and welcoming another opportunity to discuss bilateral cooperation. She expressed appreciation for Thailand's support for Japan's Indo-Pacific vision and called for stronger collaboration to improve regional economic independence and resilience. In a separate meeting with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, Takaichi emphasized the importance of maintaining close relations between Tokyo and Seoul as international conditions become increasingly difficult. She recalled their earlier meeting in Andong, Lee's hometown, in May, describing the local scenery as a particularly memorable experience. Takaichi said relations between Japan and South Korea were especially important under current international circumstances and called for the continuation of shuttle diplomacy, under which the two countries' leaders make regular reciprocal visits. She expressed hope that the arrangement would help strengthen bilateral ties and maintain communication between the governments. Lee welcomed the improvement in relations, saying public attitudes toward each other's countries had become considerably more favorable and had reached what could be described as historically high levels. He also pointed to expanding people-to-people exchanges, growing economic cooperation and closer collaboration on security matters. The South Korean president expressed appreciation for an invitation to visit Japan in January and said he looked forward to meeting Takaichi again. The series of meetings underscored Japan's efforts to strengthen diplomatic and economic relationships across Asia while maintaining close coordination with the United States. For Takaichi, the Quad summit provided an opportunity to demonstrate Japan's commitment to regional security and economic cooperation alongside three major Indo-Pacific partners. Trump's public praise of the four-country partnership, together with his remarks about Takaichi's toughness, added a personal dimension to a gathering focused on strengthening cooperation at a time of growing international uncertainty.

https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.title: NVIDIA expands supply chain commitments to support AI infrastructure growth
https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.p1: According to the Company's press release, working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. Our supply chain is a strategic advantage, said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need. NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories. Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. As per the press release, production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIAs long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms. We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime, said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together. NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIAs accelerated computing platforms. The amendment builds on the companies previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIAs compute and high-speed networking technologies. By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfil our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIAs AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality, said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics. NVIDIAs advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkors manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea. NVIDIA is supporting Amkors expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totalling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIAs long-term production needs. Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms, said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIAs production needs grow. NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029. The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. These capabilities support semiconductor products with demanding requirements for computing performance, bandwidth, power efficiency and system integration. SPIL is proud to strengthen our collaboration with NVIDIA, said C.W. Tsai, CEO and chairman of the board of SPIL. This agreement enhances our ability to support nextgeneration packaging technologies and deliver the performance and reliability required for future AI systems. The third quarter marked the first volume shipment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs for agentic AI. These products take advantage of TSMCs 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. TSMC and NVIDIA share a longstanding partnership built on semiconductor innovation, said Dr. Kevin Zhang, senior vice president and deputy co-COO at TSMC. This deep collaboration allows us to plan for future technology requirements and prepare our manufacturing capabilities as NVIDIA brings new platforms to market. Foxconn continues to deepen its collaboration with NVIDIA across next-generation GPU and networking platforms, said Young Liu, chairman of Foxconn. By leveraging its integrated global production network spanning Asia, North America, and Europe, Foxconn is well-positioned to support the volume ramp-up of next-generation AI infrastructure. These commitments build on NVIDIAs decades-long partnerships and recent commitments announced in October for manufacturing expansions with Amkor, IBIDEN, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC), Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and Unimicron. Those plans included an aggregate 2.5x increase in substrate capacity over three years, expanded advanced packaging, a doubling of semiconductor testing capacity from 2026 to 2027 and a 15x increase in SPILs optical-engine capacity by mid-2027, with aims for another doubling by the end of 2028. Our strong and long-standing collaboration with NVIDIA has continued to develop in the area of high-performance IC package substrates, said Koji Kawashima, president and chief executive officer at IBIDEN. Through the expansion of our Ono Plant, we will continue to strengthen our production capabilities and meet growing demand. Our work with NVIDIA demonstrates the value of close collaboration between chip design and semiconductor testing, said Gauss Chang, president at KYEC. Expanding our testing operations into the United States builds on that relationship and brings our capabilities closer to NVIDIAs growing US manufacturing supply chain. As AI reshapes industries and societies around the world, trusted partnerships and supply chain collaboration have never been more important, said SC Chien, chairman of Unimicron. The advanced substrate capacity investment underscores the strength of our partnership with NVIDIA and our shared commitment to support the rapid growth of AI infrastructure. By investing in advanced substrate technologies and manufacturing capabilities, Unimicron is well-positioned to help customers unlock new opportunities and share in the tremendous growth of the AI era. (ANI)

https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p1: 이재명 대통령이 18일(현지시간) 시진핑 중국 국가주석에게 한반도 문제에 대한 건설적 역할을 요청한 것은 미·중·러 정상회담을 하루 앞두고 북핵 등 한반도 현안에 한국의 입장을 반영하기 위한 외교적 대응으로 풀이된다. 강대국 간 협의에서 한국이 소외될 수 있다는 이른바 ‘한국 패싱’ 우려가 나오는 가운데, 한반도의 평화와 안정이 중국에도 공동이익이라는 점을 내세워 협력을 당부한 것이다. 시 주석은 북·미 대화 등 긴장 완화 노력을 지지한다는 뜻을 밝혔지만 중국 측 회담 결과 발표에는 한반도 관련 내용이 담기지 않았다.
https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p2: ◆미·중·러 회담 앞 중국 역할론 부각 위성락 국가안보실장은 회담 후 서면브리핑에서 한반도 문제가 ‘우리의 사활적 이익’이라는 이 대통령의 인식을 전하며, 남북 간 긴장 완화와 평화공존을 위한 중국의 건설적 역할을 요청했다고 밝혔다. 위 실장은 시 주석이 “중국은 한반도 문제 해결을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 했다고 전했다. 특히 시 주석은 최근 북·중 관계 동향을 설명하고 북·미 대화 등 한반도 긴장을 낮추기 위한 다양한 노력을 지지한다고 했다. 북한과 긴밀한 관계를 유지하는 중국이 대화 재개에 협력할 수 있다는 의사를 한국 측에 밝힌 것이다. 이 대통령은 지난 1월 베이징 정상회담에서도 북핵을 비롯한 한반도 현안에 중국의 중재 역할을 요청했다. 이번에는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 시 주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 19일 선전에서 처음으로 3자 정상회담을 갖는다는 점에서 외교적 무게가 다르다. 핵군축과 국제 안보 현안 등이 거론되지만 북핵 문제가 정식 의제에 포함되는지는 확인되지 않았다. 한반도 문제가 한국의 참여 없이 논의될 가능성에 대비해 중국 정상에게 한국의 이해관계를 직접 설명한 셈이다. 특히 강대국 간 핵군축 논의가 북핵 문제로 이어질 경우 북한 비핵화보다 핵전력의 규모와 운용을 제한하는 군비통제에 초점이 맞춰질 수 있다는 우려가 있다. 미국 본토를 위협하는 장거리 핵전력과 한국을 겨냥한 단거리 핵전력이 서로 다르게 취급될 가능성도 경계 대상이다. 청와대는 지난 17일 ‘제2의 얄타회담’ 우려에 관해 한반도 문제 등 국익과 직결된 사안에 한국의 입장과 이해관계가 충분히 반영돼야 한다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다.

https://www.digit.in/hi/features/general.title: Gemini फ्री में करेगा आपके कई अलग अलग काम! भारत में आया Google का नया AI Tasks फीचर, जानें कैसे करेगा काम
https://www.digit.in/hi/features/general.p1: अब तक Gemini से कुछ पूछने पर जवाब मिलता था। किसी सब्जेक्ट पर जानकारी चाहिए, ईमेल लिखवाना हो या कहीं घूमने का प्लान बनाना हो, AI मदद कर देता था। लेकिन असली काम पूरा करने के लिए कई बार अलग-अलग ऐप खोलने पड़ते थे। इस कारण से कई बार यूजर्स करते करते काम को बीच में ही छोड़ देते थे। हालांकि, जब गूगल को यह महसूस हुआ तो कंपनी ने इस समस्या को ही कम करने पर काम शुरू कर दिया। इसके बाद कंपनी ने अपने Tasks in Gemini फीचर के दायरे को बढ़ाना शुरू किया और इसे अब इंडिया में भी उपलब्ध करा दिया गया है। अच्छी बात यह है कि इसके लिए हर यूजर को Google AI का पेड सब्सक्रिप्शन लेने की जरूरत नहीं है, यह आपको फ्री में मिलने वाला है। Google ने 17 नवंबर को घोषणा की कि अमेरिका, भारत, कनाडा, ऑस्ट्रेलिया, जापान और दक्षिण कोरिया में यह सुविधा फ्री में मिलने वाली है। इसका मतलब है कि गूगल का यह नया फीचर आपके बहुत से काम करने वाला है और कंपनी इसके लिए आपसे पैसे भी नहीं लेने वाली है। आइए जानते हैं कि आखिर ये फीचर क्या है, कैसे काम करता है और किनके लिए यह सबसे ज्यादा उपयोगी है।
https://www.digit.in/hi/features/general.p2: यह मानकर चलिए कि आपको आने वाले कुछ दिनों में कहीं की यात्रा पर निकालना है, ऐसा कह सकते हैं कि घूमने जाना है। अब इसके लिए आपको पहले से ही होटल, घूमने की जगहों और यात्रा के कार्यक्रम की जानकारी अलग अलग करके जुटानी पड़ने वाली है। आम तौर पर आपको अलग-अलग वेबसाइटों पर जाना पड़ता है और फिर सारी जानकारी को एक जगह व्यवस्थित करनी होती है। Tasks in Gemini इसी तरह के कई चरणों वाले काम बेहद ही जल्दी और आसानी से करने के लिए ही बनाया गया है। इसका मतलब है कि जिस काम को आप लंबा समय देकर करने वाले थे, वह अब आसानी से Google का नया फीचर कर लेने वाला है।

https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CE%BD%CE%B.title: Νότια Κορέα: Ο Λι ζητεί στήριξη για επανέναρξη διαλόγου με τη Βόρεια Κορέα
https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CE%BD%CE%B.p1: Ο πρόεδρος της Νότιας Κορέας Λι Τζε-μιουνγκ ζητεί περιφερειακή στήριξη για να ξαναρχίσει ο διάλογος με τη Βόρεια Κορέα. Απηύθυνε την έκκληση κατά την ομιλία του στη σύνοδο της Οικονομικής Συνεργασίας Ασίας και Ειρηνικού στη Σεντζέν. Την ειρήνη στην Κορεατική Χερσόνησο χαρακτήρισε «προϋπόθεση» για την κοινή ευημερία στην περιοχή της Ασίας και του Ειρηνικού ο Νοτιοκορεάτης πρόεδρος. Η παρέμβασή του έγινε ενώ, σύμφωνα με δημοσιεύματα, κυκλοφορούν εικασίες για ενδεχόμενη συνάντηση του προέδρου των Ηνωμένων Πολιτειών Ντόναλντ Τραμπ με τον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας Κιμ Γιονγκ-ουν, με αφορμή τη σύνοδο. Τι επιδιώκει με την περιφερειακή στήριξη Ως αντικείμενο των συνομιλιών που επιθυμεί να ακολουθήσουν, ο Λι έθεσε τον τερματισμό του μακρόχρονου πολέμου στην Κορεατική Χερσόνησο. Παράλληλα, περιέγραψε ως στόχο την οικοδόμηση ενός διαρκούς καθεστώτος ειρήνης, προσδιορίζοντας έτσι το περιεχόμενο των συζητήσεων στις οποίες ελπίζει να οδηγήσει η πρωτοβουλία του προς τις χώρες της περιοχής. Οι επαφές των ηγετών στη Σεντζέν Στο ευρύτερο διπλωματικό πρόγραμμα της ίδιας συνόδου εντάσσεται και η άφιξη του Βλαντίμιρ Πούτιν στην Κίνα , για την οποία είχαμε γράψει νωρίτερα, με προγραμματισμένη τριμερή συνάντηση με τον Σι Τζινπίνγκ και τον Ντόναλντ Τραμπ. Ο Ρώσος πρόεδρος έχει επίσης στο πρόγραμμά του επαφές σε επίπεδο ηγετών και ομιλία στις εργασίες της Οικονομικής Συνεργασίας Ασίας και Ειρηνικού. SBC Red Line Για τον Έλληνα αναγνώστη, αξίζει να παρακολουθηθεί ποια ανταπόκριση θα βρει η έκκληση του Λι. Το ουσιαστικό διπλωματικό κριτήριο είναι αν η κινητικότητα στη σύνοδο θα οδηγήσει σε συνομιλίες για τους συγκεκριμένους στόχους ειρήνης που περιέγραψε. #ΝότιαΚορέα #ΒόρειαΚορέα #ΛιΤζε-μιουνγκ #ΝτόναλντΤραμπ #ΚιμΓιονγκ-ουν

https://www.whec.com/ap-top-news/ap-top-.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold rare 3-way talks on nuclear risks but deliver no breakthroughs - WHEC.com
https://www.whec.com/ap-top-news/ap-top-.p1: SHENZHEN, China (AP) — For U.S. President Donald Trump , the meeting with the leaders of two other nuclear powers — China’s Xi Jinping and Russia’s Vladimir Putin — was supposed to be a diplomatic triumph: It would serve as proof that Trump could negotiate with two of America’s toughest rivals. Before the trio met Thursday in a villa in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, the U.S. president sought to flatter both Xi and Putin as his friends. The wars in Ukraine and Iran were on the agenda, as was reducing the dangers posed by their nuclear arsenals. But after roughly 70 minutes behind closed doors, they agreed to a far narrower agenda. They would like to reform the United Nations, refine more fossil fuels and curb the reach of the International Criminal Court . What was billed as a historic trilateral meeting in the end looked like a fleeting photo op. Trump quickly left the villa and boarded Air Force One without saying a word to reporters about his time with Xi and Putin. Still, he hailed the visit as “Highly Consequential” on social media as he made his way back to Washington and announced he would hold a press conference on Friday at the White House. Following the Shenzhen talks, Trump dialed into a meeting in Berlin between U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy alongside more than 40 European leaders who are supporting Ukraine’s war effort. Trump told the Berlin gathering that he spoke to Xi and Putin about finding a peaceful end to the Ukraine war, Witkoff said. U.S. President Donald Trump, right, shakes hands with Russia's President Vladimir Putin, left, while posing for a group photo with other world leaders during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, China, Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026. (Sergei Bobylev/Pool Photo via AP) Photo: The agreements stemming from the trilateral meeting were modest, but the rhetoric that came at the start of it was not. “We are really making history,” Trump said. “The United States, Russia and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth and also to lessen the risk of those weapons being used.” After the meeting, Xi called it positive, constructive and fruitful, while Putin described the trilateral talks as open and candid, calling the format “useful and substantive.” “It is a serious collaborative work,” he said in response to a question about whether the image of the meeting itself mattered more than the substance. The last nuclear arms pact between Russia and the United States, known as New START, expired in February, and Trump has said he wants “a new, improved and modernized” deal that includes China. But China has less motivation to accept limits given that its arsenal of more than 600 warheads is far smaller than the more than 5,000 warheads believed to be in each of the U.S. and Russian stockpiles. Daryl Kimball, executive director of the Arms Control Association, said the meeting could at best start a process that would eventually lead to a sustained set of talks for reducing nuclear arsenals. “We need more than diplomatic theater and photo opportunities between Xi, Putin and Trump,” Kimball said. “And one meeting will not likely produce dramatic breakthroughs.” The leaders also talked about Iran and trade The U.S. president earlier had a separate one-on-one with Xi, their third substantial meeting this year. Trump said they had a shared interest in having oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz , a key waterway for oil shipments from the Middle East that was repeatedly shut because of attacks in the Iran war . Trump suggested he would push Xi to buy more agricultural products from America. Xi said that relations between the U.S. and China have been “generally stable and improved” during Trump’s presidency. The official Chinese news agency Xinhua reported that Xi discussed Taiwan with Trump and said the two countries needed to improve communication on economic and trade issues. Trump also added to his calendar a separate sit-down with Putin, marking the first time the leaders have met for talks since their discussions in Alaska last year that failed to broker a deal on Russia’s war in Ukraine . “Wonderful things can come out of this — or at least start,” Trump said, calling Putin “my friend.” Trump has frequently boasted of his rapport with Putin , as relations between the U.S. and Ukraine appear to have cratered recently. Trump rejected new Russia sanctions , while Kyiv was undermined by disruptions in satellite support for its drones during the war. After their trilateral meeting, the three leaders took aim at the International Criminal Court for overstepping its jurisdiction, saying government officials should enjoy immunity from its prosecutions. Putin is wanted by the court, and Trump’s administration has imposed sanctions on ICC officials and the institution itself as part of a campaign to dismantle the tribunal over investigations into the United States and its allies, including Israel . Trump boasts about his relationships, but the ties between Xi and Putin are stronger The U.S. president’s ambitions going into the meeting recalled an era of great power politics when wealthier countries felt entitled to decide the fate of seemingly lesser nations. Trump was negotiating with China and Russia without the involvement of Ukraine — or allies like Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Japan and South Korea that also have stakes in the outcome of any talks. Trump has long believed his ability to create personal connections gives him a diplomatic edge. Xi made a symbolic gesture of friendship Wednesday by taking the unusual step of greeting Air Force One on the tarmac, and the two leaders turned their handshake into a one-armed hug. But for all the compliments the U.S. president has showered on the two autocrats, he did not always appear to have the same deep relationship based on common interests that Xi and Putin share. On Wednesday at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit , Xi greeted Putin by calling him “my old friend.” The Russian leader responded by declaring Xi to be his “dear friend.” China has helped economically support Russia after its 2022 invasion of Ukraine , providing Putin with a financial lifeline after the U.S. and its allies imposed new sanctions. By contrast, when Xi went to the White House for a state visit in September, he was far more restrained with Trump, saying they had built a “personal rapport and stayed in touch.” Trump and Xi have one more meeting planned this year, at the G20 summit in Florida in December. There were also signs of friction Thursday in the U.S.-China relationship despite Trump’s praise of Xi. Chinese officials blocked a Bloomberg reporter from the trilateral meeting after she asked a question at the earlier Trump-Xi session. And Chinese television showed a video of Trump appearing drowsy, while the White House posted a clip of Trump helping Xi up an escalator. ___ Associated Press writers Darlene Superville, Didi Tang and Will Weissert in Washington, Huizhong Wu in Bangkok, Hanna Arhirova in Berlin and Kanis Leung in Hong Kong contributed to this report.

https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/asia/art.title: Why Kim didn't meet Trump, despite the hype  - The Standard
https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/asia/art.p1: US President Donald Trump shouts to reporters while arriving at the White House on November 19, 2026, in Washington, DC. Trump was returning from the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum in China. [AFP]
https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/asia/art.p2:
US President Donald Trump knocked repeatedly at Pyongyang's door this week for a meeting with Kim Jong Un, but the North Korean leader was out at a ski resort, a sacred mountain and then a naval university. Trump finally left Asia late Thursday after a landmark trilateral with China and Russia's presidents, but without a meeting with Kim. AFP looks at what the missed encounter means: Roles reversed Trump met Kim three times during his first White House term. Their previous summits, including in Hanoi in 2019, aimed to curb Pyongyang's nuclear programme but failed to produce a deal. Kim left Hanoi empty-handed after the talks collapsed, making a 60-hour train journey home. Since Trump's return to the White House, the US leader has repeatedly floated a new meeting with Kim. Trump reached out to Pyongyang ahead of his Asia tour last year, even describing North Korea as "sort of a nuclear power", but received no response. In March, South Korea's then-prime minister Kim Min-seok said that Trump thought a meeting with Kim would be "good". Trump raised the prospect of another meeting as he travelled to Asia this week for several summits, but Kim remained silent. The US leader later suggested that he was too busy to fit it in. "The relationship is there, but we didn't meet," Trump said Thursday, according to NBC News reporter Gabe Gutierrez, who said he spoke with the president as they were flying back to Washington from Asia. "There was too many meetings," Trump said, according to Gutierrez. "It wouldn't have worked out." Stay informed. Subscribe to our newsletter By clicking on the SIGN UP button,  you agree to our Terms & Conditions and the Privacy Policy SIGN UP Trump added: "We'll have that meeting at some point." Stay Informed, Stay Empowered: Download the Standard ePaper App! Was he overbooked? Although Trump said this week that Kim "would like to" meet, experts voiced doubts over the claim. "I am sceptical that any concrete behind-the-scenes contacts took place" between Pyongyang and Washington, Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies, told AFP. After the Hanoi summit collapsed, Kim likely "concluded that while he and Trump might understand each other personally, the US itself is fundamentally untrustworthy, regardless of whether a Republican or Democratic administration is in power", Lim added. Given Trump's penchant for impromptu diplomacy, Washington may not have pursued formal channels to arrange a summit with Pyongyang, analysts said. "A proper summit would require at least an exchange of special envoys and working-level negotiations," Koh Yu-hwan, a professor emeritus at Dongguk University, told AFP. "Kim probably had no reason to be used for a photo opportunity aimed at boosting Trump's political achievements without such preparations." What might move Pyongyang Experts say Pyongyang is highly unlikely to respond to Trump's overtures unless Washington takes concrete steps towards recognising it as a nuclear-armed state. But the US government has so far stuck to its position demanding that Pyongyang give up its nuclear weapons. Just weeks before Trump's arrival in Asia, Washington, Seoul and Tokyo reaffirmed their commitment to North Korea's "complete denuclearisation". "Trump may have personally shown goodwill towards Kim, but I don't think Kim feels that the United States, at its government level, has created a credible environment for resuming dialogue," expert Lim told AFP. Ski resort and university Rather than responding to Trump directly, North Korean state media depicted Kim visiting a ski resort and sacred Mount Paektu earlier this week, followed by a naval university on Wednesday, where he stressed maritime defence. Experts said Kim may have calculated that publicly tending to provincial matters while ignoring Trump would be a better response than remaining silent and staying in Pyongyang. After all, Pyongyang's closer ties with Beijing and Moscow give it less incentive to engage Washington. "Pyongyang is also receiving economic and military support from Russia in return for its involvement in the Ukraine war, while expanding economic cooperation with China," expert Koh said. "Despite international sanctions, it continues to generate funds through activities including hacking and cryptocurrency theft." The absence of an explicit no from Pyongyang also left open the door to a future meeting, said Yang Moo-jin, former president of the University of North Korean Studies. "It seems like Trump is still eager to meet with Kim, and Pyongyang seems to be undecided -- so the possibility cannot be ruled out," he told AFP. Ανεβάζει στροφές η παραγωγή ουρανίου Σοβαρή ανησυχία για την επέκταση του προγράμματος εμπλουτισμού ουρανίου της Βόρειας Κορέας εξέφρασε στις 18 Νοεμβρίου ο Διεθνής Οργανισμός Ατομικής Ενέργειας. Ο γενικός διευθυντής του οργανισμού Rafael Grossi έστρεψε την προσοχή σε αυτές τις ανησυχίες κατά την ομιλία του ενώπιον του συμβουλίου των διοικητών της υπηρεσίας στη Βιέννη. Ο Rafael Grossi δήλωσε ότι είχε αναφερθεί και στο παρελθόν στον συνεχιζόμενο εμπλουτισμό ουρανίου της Βόρειας Κορέας στα κέντρα σε Kangson και Yongbyon , καθώς και στην κατασκευή μιας επιπλέον εγκατάστασης στο Yongbyon, αλλά και στη συνεχιζόμενη επέκταση της παραγωγής πυρηνικού υλικού οπλικού βαθμού από το απομονωμένο κράτος. Πρόσθεσε, ωστόσο, ότι από τα μέσα Σεπτεμβρίου του 2026, «μια περαιτέρω επέκταση της αρχικής εγκατάστασης εμπλουτισμού στο Yongbyon βρισκόταν υπό κατασκευή, με τη νέα πτέρυγα να έχει ολοκληρωθεί εξωτερικά έως τα τέλη Οκτωβρίου του 2026». «Η συνεχιζόμενη επέκταση του προγράμματος εμπλουτισμού ουρανίου της Λαϊκής Δημοκρατίας της Κορέας παραμένει αιτία σοβαρής ανησυχίας», τόνισε ο Rafael Grossi . Οι αντιδραστήρες στη Yongbyon βρίσκονται ξανά σε πλήρη λειτουργία παραβιάζοντας κατάφωρα τα ψηφίσματα του Συμβουλίου Ασφαλείας Ο επικεφαλής του οργανισμού ανέφερε ότι ο Διεθνής Οργανισμός Ατομικής Ενέργειας , στον οποίο δεν επιτρέπεται η είσοδος στη Βόρεια Κορέα από το 2009, παρατήρησε ενδείξεις ότι ο αντιδραστήρας των 5 μεγαβάτ στη Yongbyon «πιθανότατα συνεχίζει να λειτουργεί στον έβδομο κύκλο ακτινοβόλησής του, και ότι, μετά από μια περίοδο διακοπής, ο αντιδραστήρας ελαφρού ύδατος στη Yongbyon λειτουργεί από τα τέλη Απριλίου του 2026». Ο Rafael Grossi χαρακτήρισε τις ενέργειες της Πιονγιάνγκ ως «σαφείς παραβιάσεις των σχετικών ψηφισμάτων του Συμβουλίου Ασφαλείας του ΟΗΕ», χαρακτηρίζοντας τις κινήσεις αυτές «βαθιά λυπηρές». Πρόσθεσε ότι ο Διεθνής Οργανισμός Ατομικής Ενέργειας εξακολουθεί να διατηρεί «αυξημένη ετοιμότητα» στον ρόλο του για την επαλήθευση του πυρηνικού προγράμματος της κομμουνιστικής χώρας. Η έκρηξη νάρκης στη μεθόριο πυροδότησε νέα πολεμική ένταση στην κορεατική χερσόνησο Η είδηση της επέκτασης των σχεδίων εμπλουτισμού της Πιονγιάνγκ έρχεται σε μια περίοδο αυξανόμενης έντασης στην κορεατική χερσόνησο. Τόσο η Βόρεια Κορέα όσο και η Νότια Κορέα έχουν πραγματοποιήσει πυραυλικές δοκιμές τους τελευταίους μήνες, με τις σχέσεις μεταξύ των δύο χωρών, οι οποίες τεχνικά παραμένουν σε εμπόλεμη κατάσταση, να έχουν επιδεινωθεί στον απόηχο μιας έκρηξης νάρκης στην αποστρατιωτικοποιημένη ζώνη που τραυμάτισε έναν αριθμό στρατιωτών της Σεούλ . Έκτοτε, η Σεούλ ζήτησε συγγνώμη, αποναρκοθέτησε το σημείο και πρότεινε στρατιωτικές συνομιλίες με τη Βόρεια Κορέα για την αποκλιμάκωση των εντάσεων. Η Πιονγιάνγκ δεν έχει ακόμη αναγνωρίσει την πρόταση της Σεούλ , απορρίπτοντας το ζήτημα της έκρηξης της νάρκης ως «φάρσα», ενώ είχε απειλήσει να επαναλάβει τις προπαγανδιστικές μεταδόσεις μέσω μεγαφώνων κατά μήκος των συνόρων πριν από τα τέλη Οκτωβρίου. Ωστόσο, μέχρι στιγμής, ο στρατός της Νότιας Κορέας δεν έχει αναφέρει ότι εντόπισε τέτοιες ενέργειες. Οι μεταδόσεις μέσω μεγαφώνων αποτελούν μια παλιομοδίτικη τακτική ψυχολογικού πολέμου της εποχής του Ψυχρού Πολέμου, την οποία οι δύο Κορέες χρησιμοποιούσαν περιστασιακά η μία εναντίον της άλλης σε περιόδους αντιπαράθεσης. Συνάντηση Donald Trump - Kim Jong Un. Ο πρόεδρος των ΗΠΑ Donald Trump δήλωσε ότι ενδέχεται να συναντηθεί με τον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας Kim Jong Un σε μεταγενέστερο χρόνο, σύμφωνα με όσα μετέφερε ο δημοσιογράφος του NBC News Gabe Gutierrez μέσω της πλατφόρμας X, αναφέροντας τα λόγια του Αμερικανού προέδρου. «Κάποια στιγμή θα πραγματοποιήσουμε μια συνάντηση», ανέφερε ο Donald Trump κατά τη διάρκεια συνέντευξης που παραχώρησε στο τηλεοπτικό δίκτυο. Το βαρύ πρόγραμμα της περιοδείας στην Ασία ακύρωσε τα σχέδια για άμεσες διαπραγματεύσεις Ο Αμερικανός πρόεδρος εξήγησε ότι κατά τη διάρκεια του ταξιδιού του στην Ασία είχε προγραμματίσει υπερβολικά πολλές συναντήσεις, γεγονός που κατέστησε αδύνατη τη διοργάνωση συνομιλιών με τον Kim Jong Un. Ο Donald Trump υπολόγιζε να συναντηθεί με τον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας σ το περιθώριο της συνόδου κορυφής του Οργανισμού Οικονομικής Συνεργασίας Ασίας-Ειρηνικού, η οποία διεξήχθη στις 18 και 19 Νοεμβρίου στην κινεζική πόλη Shenzhen. Σύμφωνα με την εφημερίδα The Wall Street Journal , ο ένοικος του Λευκού Οίκου ήλπιζε να συζητήσει με τον Βορειοκορεάτη ηγέτη την επανέναρξη των διαπραγματεύσεων για το πυρηνικό πρόγραμμα της Πιονγιάνγκ. Οι 112 πυρηνικοί πύραυλοι και οι αμοιβαίες συμπάθειες καθορίζουν τις κινήσεις της Ουάσινγκτον Προηγουμένως, ο Donald Trump είχε αποκαλέσει τον Kim Jong Un φίλο του και είχε δηλώσει ότι μπορεί να αισθάνεται ασφαλής όσο ο ίδιος παραμένει στην εξουσία. Ο Αμερικανός ηγέτης θεωρεί τον εαυτό του τον «μοναδικό άνθρωπο σε ολόκληρο τον κόσμο» που είναι συμπαθής στον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας , σημειώνοντας ότι και ο ίδιος τρέφει συμπάθεια προς το πρόσωπό του. Επιπλέον, αναγνώρισε ότι «όταν ένας άνθρωπος διαθέτει 112 πυρηνικούς πυραύλους, είναι σημαντικό να τα πηγαίνεις καλά μαζί του». Νωρίτερα, ο Donald Trump είχε δείξει μια «μη φιλική φωτογραφία» με τον Kim Jong Un, διαβεβαιώνοντας ωστόσο ότι σε άλλες φωτογραφίες οι δύο άνδρες χαμογελούν. Κούρσα εξοπλισμών με πυρηνοκίνητα υποβρύχια ξεσπά από τη Νότια Κορέα έως την Αυστραλία και τη Βραζιλία Ο Rafael Grossi σημείωσε επίσης ότι βρίσκονται σε εξέλιξη διαβουλεύσεις με τη γειτονική της Πιονγιάνγκ, Νότια Κορέα, σχετικά με τη ναυτική πυρηνική πρόωση, καθώς και ξεχωριστές συζητήσεις με την Αυστραλία και τη Βραζιλία για το ίδιο θέμα. Η Νότια Κορέα ανακοίνωσε τον Μάιο την πρόθεσή της να καθελκύσει τα πρώτα της πυρηνοκίνητα υποβρύχια στα μέσα της δεκαετίας του 2030, στο πλαίσιο των μέτρων της χώρας για την αντιμετώπιση της επιθετικότητας από τη Βόρεια Κορέα. Ο τότε υπουργός Άμυνας της Νότιας Κορέας Ahn Gyu-back δήλωσε στις 26 Μαΐου, σε συνάντηση αμυντικής στρατηγικής, ότι το έργο θα αναπτύξει πυρηνοκίνητα σκάφη που θα χρησιμοποιούν χαμηλού εμπλουτισμού ουράνιο, κάτω από 20 τοις εκατό, ως καύσιμο. Αν και πυρηνοκίνητα, τα υποβρύχια προορίζονται να εξοπλιστούν μόνο με συμβατικά όπλα. Η προσπάθεια της Σεούλ να ναυπηγήσει πυρηνοκίνητα υποβρύχια έρχεται αφότου οι Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες έδωσαν στη Νότια Κορέα τη στήριξή τους για να προχωρήσει στα σχέδια τον Οκτώβριο του 2025. Η Αυστραλία επιδιώκει επίσης τον δικό της στόλο πυρηνοκίνητων υποβρυχίων υπό την αιγίδα της συμμαχίας AUKUS μεταξύ της Καμπέρα, του Λονδίνου και της Ουάσινγκτον . Ιδρυθείσα τον Σεπτέμβριο του 2021, η AUKUS είναι μια τριμερής εταιρική σχέση ασφαλείας που αποσκοπεί στην ενίσχυση της αμυντικής συνεργασίας και της ασφάλειας στον Ινδο-Ειρηνικό. Ένα κεντρικό στοιχείο της συμφωνίας, γνωστό ως Πυλώνας 1, περιλαμβάνει την απόκτηση από την Αυστραλία συμβατικά εξοπλισμένων, πυρηνοκίνητων υποβρυχίων για την τελική αντικατάσταση του στόλου της κλάσης Collins. https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611221840.p2: ■중동·유럽 넘어 동북아로 '충돌의 축' 이동 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 이후 재편되는 미·중·러 3각 구도의 본질은 '전선의 선택과 집중'이다. 미국은 중간선거를 기점으로 대외 안보 정책의 우선순위를 다듬고 있다. 장기화된 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁에 대해서는 유럽 동맹국들의 방위비 분담과 자체 억제력 강화를 지속 압박하며, 종전 또는 동결 협상의 지렛대를 쥐려 하고, 중동에서는 압도적 군사력과 AI 기반 정밀 타격 역량을 앞세워 이란의 핵·미사일 위협을 억제하는 '관리형 억지' 기조로 전환하는 움직임이 뚜렷하다. 퀸시 연구소(Quincy Institute) 등 현실주의 싱크탱크 분석에 따르면, 미국이 린지 그레이엄법(대러·대이란 제재법)을 유예하면서 러시아산 디젤 수출을 허용한 정책도 미국 내 디젤 가격 안정과 모스크바를 러우전쟁 협상 테이블로 끌어내려는 전략적 퇴로를 열어주기 위한 현실적 거래 레버리지 움직임으로 분석했다. 워싱턴이 이처럼 서반구와 유라시아 서쪽의 부담을 덜어내려는 궁극적 목적은 바로 대중(對中) 억제력 집중에 있다. 미 국방부(전쟁부)가 주한미군과 인도-태평양 역내 미군 전력의 '전략적 유연성'과 다영역 통합작전(CJADO)을 강조하는 배경도 여기에 있다.

https://www.slashfilm.com/1217858/silly-.title: Silly Symphonies: The Oscar-Winning Disney Animation Series That The Studio Forgot
https://www.slashfilm.com/1217858/silly-.p1: As someone who is more interested in the history of the Walt Disney Company than its recent offerings, I've noticed some interesting gaps in terms of popular coverage. When people do talk about the company itself and its early contributions to the world of animation, the conversation is usually focused on the Mickey Mouse shorts and "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs." If a nerd film historian is really showing off their deep understanding of Disney lore, they may also bring up Oswald the Lucky Rabbit or even the Disney Brothers Studio's first hit, the Alice Comedies .
https://www.slashfilm.com/1217858/silly-.p2: For whatever reason, the time between "Steamboat Willie" debuting in 1928 and "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs" in 1937 isn't really talked about in the fandom circles. I found a few documentaries on YouTube, including the making of featurette "Silly Symphonies Rediscovered, " but nothing that had more than about 15,000 views. Contrast this with the Silly Symphonies shorts themselves, which have tens of millions of views, even when uploaded by unofficial channels (this may be because they are categorized as "YouTube Kids" content, but that's a whole other rabbit hole). There are countless "the dark history of" or "the truth behind" style videos that purport to cover the company's salacious past (with varying degrees of accuracy), and many of these have hundreds of thousands of views.

https://aninews.in/news/business/satelli.title: Satellite internet rollout in India nearing next phase, Starlink awaits spectrum allocation, Jio eyes 2029 constellation: ISpA
https://aninews.in/news/business/satelli.p2: New Delhi [India], November 23 (ANI): India’s satellite communication market is moving closer to a wider rollout, with OneWeb ready to provide services, Starlink awaiting final spectrum allocation and Reliance Jio planning a large satellite constellation by 2029, Lt Gen Anil Kumar Bhatt (Retd.), Director General of the Indian Space Association (ISpA), said on Monday. Speaking to ANI on the sidelines of the India International Space Conclave 2026, Lt Gen Bhatt said OneWeb’s satellites were ready to provide services in India, while Starlink was waiting for the final allocation of spectrum. “Starlink is also going to come into India very soon. They are waiting for the final spectrum allocation for them,” he said, adding that Jio plans to deploy a large satellite communication constellation by 2029. The entry of satellite communication providers into India has also drawn attention amid concerns over market access and competition. In October, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk alleged that powerful business interests were attempting to block Starlink’s entry to protect existing operators. The government rejected the allegations, maintaining that the licensing process was transparent and uniform. On November 6, government sources told ANI that Jio, OneWeb and Starlink had all secured licences, but commercial services would begin only after the spectrum allocation and pricing framework was finalised and the operators met security requirements. Starlink was the last of the three to submit its compliance documents.

https://tidende.dk/ind-og-udland/udland/.title: Russisk flyaktivitet får Sydkorea til at sende kampfly på vingerne
https://tidende.dk/ind-og-udland/udland/.p1: Sydkorea vil indkalde russisk forsvarsattaché til samtale efter russiske kampfly fløj ind i luftforsvarszone.
https://tidende.dk/ind-og-udland/udland/.p2: Det meddeler Sydkoreas generalstab, JCS, i en udtalelse ifølge nyhedsbureauet Reuters. Kadiz er ikke en del af Sydkoreas eget luftrum, men en såkaldt bufferzone, hvor landet af sikkerhedshensyn holder øje med fly, der nærmer sig. Det sydkoreanske militær fulgte de russiske fly, allerede da de nærmede sig luftforsvarszonen, og deres kampfly gennemførte såkaldte taktiske manøvrer, lyder det fra JCS. De russiske kampfly krænkede ikke Sydkoreas luftrum, fremgår det. Selv om det ikke er et krav, ventes militærfly som udgangspunkt at underrette et land, inden de flyver ind i dets luftforsvarszone. Mens de russiske kampfly befandt sig i Kadiz, nærmede de sig øen Ulleung, der ligger ved den sydkoreanske østkyst. Det fik Sydkoreas sikkerhedsministerium til at udsende en advarsel til øens beboere. Her blev de opfordret til at søge tilflugt indendørs eller i underjordiske anlæg, skriver nyhedsbureauet AFP. Advarslen blev ophævet tre minutter senere i de tidlige morgentimer i Sydkorea. Sydkoreas forsvarsministerium har efterfølgende meddelt, at det vil indkalde Ruslands forsvarsattaché til en samtale for at udtrykke landets utilfredshed med hændelsen. Også for en uge siden sendte det sydkoreanske militær kampfly på vingerne, efter at der var blevet registreret formodede russiske fly i landets luftforsvarszone. Det samme gjorde Japan, hvor to formodede russiske kampfly havde krænket landets luftrum nær øen Okinoshima. Rusland og Japan har i årtier været uenige om tilhørsforholdet for en række øer i Stillehavet. Forholdet mellem de to lande er ikke blevet bedre, efter at Japan har tilsluttet sig internationale sanktioner mod Rusland som følge af krigen i Ukraine. RITZAU

https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4370403.title: Coreia do Sul envia caças após aviões russos entrarem em zona de defesa aérea - 24/11/2026 | Diário do Grande ABC
https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4370403.p2: A Coreia do Sul enviou caças nesta terça-feira (24) para acompanhar aeronaves militares russas que entraram em sua zona de identificação de defesa aérea, sobre águas entre a Península Coreana e o Japão. O Estado-Maior sul-coreano esclareceu que os aviões não violaram o espaço aéreo territorial do país, ao contrário do que informaram inicialmente autoridades do governo. O alerta para os moradores da ilha de Ulleung foi suspenso três minutos depois de ser emitido. A ordem, divulgada por volta das 7h52 (horário local), orientava a população a buscar abrigo em instalações subterrâneas ou edifícios. Segundo os militares, as aeronaves russas se aproximaram do espaço aéreo da ilha, mas deixaram a área de risco. O porta-voz do Estado-Maior, Jang Do-young, afirmou que a força aérea mobilizou caças por precaução. Ele disse que o governo pretende apresentar um protesto a Moscou sobre o incidente. Não foram informados o número nem os modelos das aeronaves. Antes da correção dos militares, o Ministério do Interior e da Segurança havia informado que aviões russos violaram o espaço aéreo sul-coreano. O governo provincial também emitiu um alerta, dizendo que as aeronaves poderiam ser norte-coreanas. Jang afirmou que o episódio será investigado e que o alerta provincial pode ter sido enviado por engano. Uma zona de identificação de defesa aérea se estende além do espaço aéreo territorial e permite que as forças armadas identifiquem e acompanhem aeronaves estrangeiras. Segundo Jang, aviões russos já entraram várias vezes na zona sul-coreana neste ano. A ilha de Ulleung, com cerca de 9 mil habitantes, não registrou grandes transtornos. O incidente ocorre uma semana depois de a Coreia do Sul mobilizar caças diante de outra incursão temporária de aeronaves russas em sua zona de defesa aérea. Na mesma ocasião, o Japão também protestou contra Moscou, após relatar a entrada de dois aviões suspeitos em seu espaço aéreo. Fonte: Associated Press. *Conteúdo traduzido com auxílio de Inteligência Artificial, revisado e editado pela Redação do Broadcast , sistema de notícias em tempo real do Grupo Estado.

https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/africa/a.title: North Korea threatens to close Swiss diplomatic office  - The Standard
https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/africa/a.p1:
The powerful sister of North Korea's supreme leader threatened Tuesday to close Switzerland's diplomatic office just weeks after it opened, in retaliation for new sanctions imposed by the European country. In a statement carried by state news agency KCNA, Kim Yo Jong, sister of Kim Jong Un, denounced new Swiss sanctions on a camp in the North Korean city of Wonsan attended by Chinese and Russian children. The Songdowon International Children's Camp has been accused of helping to indoctrinate Ukrainian children brought from Russian-occupied territories. Switzerland is one of the few Western countries to maintain dialogue with Pyongyang and the rebuke comes just weeks after the Swiss foreign minister visited North Korea, where he discussed normalising relations. "It is my view that the Swiss diplomatic office has spontaneously lost justification for its existence," Kim Yo Jong said in a statement. "I will advise our Foreign Ministry to strictly examine the issue of withdrawing the Swiss diplomatic office from Pyongyang in a few days and take a relevant measure," she added. The diplomatic office was formally reopened in late October around the time of Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis's visit -- the first such trip by a Swiss minister since 2003. Switzerland -- where both Kim Jong Un and Kim Yo Jong studied -- sanctioned the camp on November 4, accusing it of participating in the "transfer of Ukrainian children from temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine" to North Korea and contributing to "efforts aimed at the ideological conditioning and russification of Ukrainian children". The Swiss diplomatic office reports to the Swiss embassy in Beijing, which handles diplomatic and consular relations with North Korea. At the time of the visit, Bern said it noted that it "rigorously applies UN sanctions" on North Korea. But the latest sanctions on the summer camp have been met with a strong rebuke. "It is very doubtful whether we can get something in the relations with Bern, which denies the sovereignty of the DPRK and even the freedom and human rights of its people, following the lead of London and Brussels," Kim Yo Jong also said in her statement. Switzerland had long served as a diplomatic intermediary between North Korea and the West before its Pyongyang office closed during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020. North Korea maintains an embassy in Bern. Stay informed. The threatened withdrawal, if realised, would undermine efforts by the South and the US to engage with the North, Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies, told AFP. "Neutral Switzerland, where leader Kim spent part of his childhood, has maintained relatively friendly ties with North Korea, serving as an informal mediator," he said. The withdrawal would "inevitably deal a blow to potential efforts by Washington and Seoul to engage Pyongyang through indirect diplomatic channels", he added. Kim Yo Jong's statement follows North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's snubbing of US President Donald Trump's overtures for a meeting during his visit to China last week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. The Wall Street Journal reported over the weekend that Pyongyang and Washington had considered arranging a face-to-face meeting, but the plans fell apart when Kim demanded conditions that the US side could not accept. The report did not elaborate on the conditions. Having issued no response to Trump's outreach, Kim Jong Un told newly arrived ambassadors on Sunday that Pyongyang would "expand and develop foreign relations... on the principle of defending the national sovereignty and security". Trump and Kim met three times during the US president's first term in an effort to curb Pyongyang's nuclear programme. https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: Seoul voices regret to Moscow over Russian jets’ flight near Ulleung Island
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: Russian military aircraft entered Korea’s air defense identification zone (KADIZ) near Ulleung Island in the East Sea on Tuesday, leading the Korean Air Force to scramble jets in response. While the Russian aircraft did not actually enter Korea’s territorial airspace, the incident nevertheless resulted in alarming alerts being sent out to residents. The Korean government expressed regret to Russia through diplomatic channels. “Several Russian military aircraft entered the KADIZ over the East Sea and approached Ulleung Island before departing when our forces took a military response,” the Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff said on Tuesday morning. “There was no violation of our airspace.” The Russian aircraft reportedly flew south toward Ulleung Island but then changed course and left the KADIZ after Korean F-15K fighters took tactical measures in the air. A military official said the Russian aircraft were traveling at an average speed of 600-700 kilometers per hour, or about 200 meters per second. “That should give you an idea of the urgency of the situation,” the official added. A total of four Russian aircraft reportedly entered the KADIZ, with bombers among them. The Korean government immediately lodged a protest. The Ministry of National Defense summoned Col. Nikolai Marchenko, Russia’s defense attaché in Seoul. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not summon the Russian ambassador but expressed regret through diplomatic channels and urged Moscow to prevent similar incidents in the future. Russia, which does not recognize other countries’ air defense identification zones, has sent military aircraft into the KADIZ three times over the past week. Confusion also arose over emergency alerts sent to residents to notify them of the Russian aircraft’s entry into the KADIZ. At 7:53 am, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety sent out an alert declaring that Russian military aircraft had “violated our airspace” and instructing residents to evacuate. Then around 8 am, North Gyeongsang Province sent an emergency alert to residents of Ulleung County stating that an aircraft “believed to be North Korean had left the danger zone.” The provincial government subsequently issued a correction. The erroneous message was traced back to an employee who had inadvertently sent out wording intended for use in training.

https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: Russia sends 3 messages at once with strategic bomber flight near South Korea
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: Russian supersonic strategic bombers came within seconds of entering South Korean airspace near Ulleung Island on Tuesday in an unprecedented move that is raising questions about Moscow’s intentions. Russian military aircraft enter Korea’s air defense identification zone (KADIZ) several dozen times a year, but never before has a nuclear-capable strategic bomber come so close to Korean airspace. Some analysts believe Russia was seeking to demonstrate its commitment to its alliance with North Korea. According to South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff, a Russian strategic bomber formation entered the KADIZ around 7:40 am on Tuesday and flew south toward Ulleung Island. By 7:52 am, the aircraft had approached within 13 nautical miles of the island and just 1 nautical mile from the boundary of Korean airspace. Another two or three seconds of flight would have taken them into Korean airspace. The South Korean military responded by scrambling several F-15K fighter jets. Russia’s Defense Ministry identified the aircraft flying over the East Sea that day as Tu-160 strategic bombers conducting a scheduled flight over international waters, according to Russia’s TASS news agency. The flight lasted approximately 10 hours, with the bombers escorted by Su-35S and Su-30SM fighter jets from the Russian Aerospace Forces. The Russian Defense Ministry said its aircraft strictly comply with international rules on the use of airspace in all flights. The Tu-160 is a supersonic long-range strategic bomber capable of carrying nuclear missiles, with a maximum range of over 12,000 kilometers. Its all-white paint scheme has earned it the moniker “White Swan.” The formation that entered KADIZ consisted of four aircraft: two Tu-160 bombers with an escort of one Su-35S and one Su-30SM fighter. Korea’s Defense Ministry summoned the Russian defense attaché, a colonel in the air force, to lodge a protest. The Foreign Ministry did not summon the Russian ambassador but expressed regret through diplomatic channels and urged Moscow to ensure that such an incident is not repeated. Russia’s Foreign Ministry, meanwhile, announced that Korean Ambassador to Russia Lee Sok-bae had met with Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko to discuss pressing issues.
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p2: The incident was unusual in several respects. For one thing, the nuclear-capable Tu-160 strategic bomber has never before made an appearance over the East Sea (also called the Sea of Japan). Known as the world’s largest supersonic strategic bomber, the Tu-160 can carry air-launched cruise missiles fitted with nuclear warheads and reach speeds of around Mach 2. Russia gave North Korean leader Kim Jong-un a tour of its strategic bombers, including the Tu-160, during his visit to Vladivostok in September 2023. Russia has sent Tu-95MS bombers into the KADIZ on multiple previous occasions. But on this occasion, it sent the supersonic Tu-160 to the very edge of South Korean airspace, cranking up the pressure on Seoul. Russian military aircraft have recently passed through the KADIZ on their way to Japan’s air defense identification zone. This time, however, the Russian aircraft did not continue toward Japan after narrowly skirting South Korean airspace over Ulleung Island, suggesting that the operation was aimed specifically at South Korea. Experts believe Russia’s primary objective was to demonstrate to North Korea that it is fulfilling its obligations under their Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, while also using the show of force to put pressure on the South Korean government. Russia and North Korea’s treaty, signed in June 2024, pledges mutual military assistance. Russian President Vladimir Putin emphasized the two countries’ brotherhood in arms and their commitment to the treaty in a meeting with Jo Yong-won, a senior official in North Korea’s ruling party, on Nov. 16. “The fact that Russia’s strategic bombers only brushed by South Korea this time without continuing on to Japan suggests that the operation was intended to send a message to both South and North Korea,” said Doo Jin-ho, a visiting research fellow at Kyungnam University’s Institute for Far Eastern Studies. “North Korea has sent combat troops to Russia, but Russia hadn’t previously rotated strategic assets into the region. It apparently wanted to show the North that it’s honoring its defense commitments,” Doo said. Lee Byong-chul, a professor at the same institute, said that Russia was “visibly demonstrating its commitment to defending North Korea under their bilateral treaty while also providing deterrence against the South Korea-US alliance and signaling that it could intervene in a contingency on the Korean Peninsula.” “Just as the US deploys strategic weapons to the Korean Peninsula under its mutual defense treaty with South Korea, Russia may continue deploying strategic weapons in the future as North Korea’s military backer,” Lee said.

https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.title: North Koreaâs Kim urges wider tactical nuclear weapons deployment on facility tour, KCNA says
https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.p1: SEOUL, Nov 26 (Reuters) - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un said his country should focus on deploying tactical nuclear weapons across multiple domains and that its nuclear material production capacity was being systematically expanded, state media KCNA reported on Thursday.
https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/.p2: By Kyu-seok Shim Kim, who spoke during an inspection on Wednesday of nuclear material production and weapons research facilities, also said North Koreaâs status as a nuclear weapons state was âabsolutely inviolableâ. KCNA did not identify the facilities or their locations. âOur nuclear capability is now a reality,â KCNA quoted Kim as saying. Kim said North Korea should âfocus on utilising tactical nuclear weapons across multiple domains for different missionsâ and called recent achievements in nuclear weapons production a major success for the countryâs nuclear force policy. The tour of the nuclear facilities appears aimed at underscoring Pyongyangâs push to expand and diversify its nuclear arsenal in defiance of calls for denuclearisation, as questions persist over prospects for renewed dialogue with the United States. Tactical nuclear weapons are generally lower-yield warheads meant for battlefield use, unlike strategic weapons designed for longer-range strikes. In 2023, KCNA published images of what it called the Hwasan-31 tactical nuclear warhead, saying it could be fitted to a range of delivery systems, including short-range missiles. Photographs released by KCNA on Thursday showed Kim and officials inspecting objects that analysts said looked like gas centrifuges, used to enrich uranium, and miniaturised, standardised tactical nuclear warheads such as the Hwasan-31. Kim also said any attempt to deny North Koreaâs nuclear status, which it enshrined in its constitution in 2023, would be regarded as âan open declaration of warâ. âOur possession of nuclear weapons is an absolutely irreversible choice as long as malicious forces exist that use nuclear weapons as a means of achieving hegemony,â Kim said. KIM CITES US NUCLEAR ALLIANCES Kim justified the buildup by citing what he described as growing nuclear threats from the United States and its allies. The United States had âincited its vassal statesâ near North Korea to acquire nuclear-powered submarines by introducing the âdangerous precedent of nuclear proliferation through AUKUS to Northeast Asia,â he said, referring to the trilateral security pact involving the United States, Britain and Australia. He also accused Washington of building a ânuclear military alliance systemâ by trying to share and use nuclear weapons with its allies. South Korea is pursuing nuclear-powered submarines after US President Donald Trump approved the plan in October last year. The topic has also been under discussion in Japan. Analysts said the visit carried a message for Washington amid speculation about US-North Korea diplomatic contact. âThis is not so much North Korea permanently closing the door to dialogue with the United States as a strategy of raising the bar: âdenuclearisation talksâ are over, and if talks open in future, it will deal only on a ânuclear state versus nuclear stateâ basis,â said Lim Eul-chul, a professor at South Koreaâs Kyungnam University. Shin Jong-woo, secretary-general of the Korea Defence and Security Forum, said Kimâs reference to âmultiple domainsâ could signal targets beyond the Korean peninsula, including the US mainland. Kimâs intent âseems to be that with no alternatives now, Pyongyang will build up its nuclear forces further and head toward a setup in which it can confront the US,â Shin said. North Korea has conducted six nuclear tests since 2006, with its last and most powerful test in 2017. South Koreaâs defence minister said in August that Pyongyang was believed to possess between 80 and 120 nuclear warheads, but said the estimate came from private research organisations and could not be officially confirmed. (Reporting by Kyu-seok Shim; Editing by Edmund Klamann and Ed Davies)
